tip.title: Get cruise check-in details ready before Saturday
tip.body: Carnival online check-in opens Saturday morning, so set aside your ID, emergency contact, and a clear, well-lit photo of yourself tonight or tomorrow. Having those in one place turns check-in into a five-minute task instead of a scavenger hunt, and a reminder is already set for Saturday.

ottoman.summary: There was no single Ottoman front in the Great War. Gallipoli stopped the Allies at the Straits and preserved the capital, while Sarıkamış, Mesopotamia, Sinai, and Palestine drained the empire elsewhere. Local victories bought time, but hunger, disease, and broken supply lines left Ottoman leaders exhausted by autumn 1918.

surprise.title: Rocky Horror at Askew, 10 PM
surprise.body: Your Russian block ends at 8:00 PM, and FSU's full Rocky Horror Picture Show experience starts at 10:00 PM at Askew Student Life Center with pre-show games and a live White Mouse Productions shadowcast. It runs through about 2:00 AM and repeats Saturday at 10:00 PM, so tonight is the easy post-study option without cutting into language time. Askew is on Learning Way on the FSU campus, roughly a ten-minute drive from downtown Tallahassee.
